baseline: A0 = frozen B1024 pipeline: phase4_exp_b_width1024 (checkpoint a2f9d737edca...), PP-OCRv6_medium_det, header split on, produced by demo.local_pdf_ocr.quality.e2e_regression --rerun-only

documents.allowed: PDFs never used for H1 design or for any earlier evaluation (registration refuses every PDF whose SHA-256 is in experiment_sources.json)
documents.reserved: 30.signed.pdf may enter only an authorized blind round; nothing in this repository opens it before that
documents.born_digital_definition: a PDF whose pages are native_text (H1 page class) for at least half of its pages

selection.changed_lines: every line whose H1 text differs from A0 (census, no cap)
selection.representative: per PDF a uniform random sample of min(30, line count) lines; seed = int(sha256('h1-blind-v1|' + pdf_sha256))
selection.queue: one queue per source PDF holding the union of both sets, shuffled with seed = int(sha256('h1-blind-v1-order|' + pdf_sha256)); set membership is never shown to the reviewer

references.source: independent human transcriptions only, from experiments.hybrid_h1.blind queues: the page shows the line image and nothing a machine read (no A0, no H1, no PDF text layer, no label)
references.primary: final text of items whose final status is verified (blind entry, then the reviewer's own second look at the image; a change needs a written reason)
references.sensitivity: the blind-locked text of the same items
references.excluded: uncertain, not_text and unreadable items (counted, never scored)
references.never: the PDF text layer is never a reference

normalization: Unicode NFC; micro Levenshtein CER/WER; no case folding; no punctuation removal

go.B1: changed lines: H1 character errors < A0, improved lines > regressed lines, one-sided exact sign test p < B1_sign_test_alpha
go.B2: changed lines: exact one-sided 95% upper bound of regressed/changed <= B2_max_regression_rate_upper95
go.B3: zero key-field instances (document number, e-mail, agency name, date) that are correct under A0 and wrong under H1, on every scored line
go.B4: scanned PDFs: H1 character errors <= A0 and zero regressed lines
go.B5: no PDF with more H1 than A0 character errors on its scored lines
go.B6: representative set: H1 micro CER <= A0 micro CER
go.B7: integrity: freeze verified; every fallback line byte-identical to A0; line order and polygons identical to A0; exports valid and complete
go.B8: B1 and B3 also hold with the blind-locked transcriptions

verdicts.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: any sufficiency rule fails: no verdict on H1
verdicts.NO_GO: sufficiency met and any of B1-B7 fails
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: sufficiency met, B1-B7 hold, B8 fails
verdicts.GO_CANDIDATE_FOR_USER_DECISION: sufficiency met and B1-B8 hold; deployment still needs an explicit decision by the user

reported_not_gating: cluster bootstrap 95% interval of (A0 - H1) CER on changed lines, resampling PDFs (10,000 resamples, seed 20261017)
per-PDF and per-group metrics, WER, exact-line rate, selection and fallback rates
one_shot: the blind round is scored once; no threshold, gate or code changes after any blind label exists; a changed candidate is a new candidate and needs a new blind set
